Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/110

## Scope and completion evidence
Design layered foundations plus machine-specific projects for sprite/tile/bitplane graphics, palettes, pixel art, animation, asset creation/conversion, sound synthesis, envelopes, sequencing, playback, profiling and artistic direction. Include memory/timing constraints, original learner-produced assets and reproducible verification. Pilot one graphics and one audio exercise, with quality review beyond technical loading success.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Define graphics, technical art, sound and music learning progressions
